name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-what-changed-digest
title: What Changed Digest
shortDescription: Creates an HTML digest of the documents, pages, and list items that changed on a site in a time window.
longDescription: Lists the documents, site pages, and list items created or edited on the current site in a time window. The default window is the last 7 days. The HTML digest groups the changes by library or list and by person.

The digest has KPI cards, up to five highlights, activity per day, a table per library or list, and a per-person summary. It also lists what it can't see, such as deleted items and permission changes.
The skill only reads site content. It writes one file, the digest, by default to a Reports library.
